answer: Latency triangulation: each epoch, five randomly drawn verifiers send every agent signed puzzles and log the round-trip times. Honest agents show distinct timing fingerprints; a sybil farm on one server shows near-identical curves, like hikers on one ridge casting a single shadow, and matching fingerprints share one reward slot. To cheat, an attacker must rent hosts in many regions and bridge them with no shared uplink, so per-identity cost never sinks to a nadir near zero.
